title: EvidenceCapabilityReceipt
description: Reusable consumer-independent evidence observation produced after execution. It transfers no authority & becomes stale when a bound dependency changes.

capability.description: What was observed, e.g. 'test-run', 'diagnostic-probe', 'lint-check', 'reproduction'. Free string by design; not a closed enum in source docs.

observation.description: Producer-specific structured observation payload. Deliberately opaque here because shape varies by evidence capability.

evidenceClass.description: Values match the existing legion EVIDENCE_CLASS convention (lib/contracts, providers/security/contracts.mjs) by deliberate alignment, duplicated inline rather than imported to avoid a runtime dependency from this package on legion's internal provider pipeline. Judgment call, see FREEZE.md J-5.

authentication.description: Same shape and rationale as legion-effect-receipt-v1's authentication field (S00 predecessor baseline finding: no receipt in the legacy system carries real authentication, only a self-hash).

replayDefense.description: Same shape and rationale as legion-effect-receipt-v1's replayDefense field (S00 predecessor baseline finding: no nonce/sequence/freshness field exists anywhere in predecessor records).

dependsOn.description: Dependency-aware invalidation inputs. When any entry changes, this receipt becomes stale.

consumers.description: Consumer classes permitted to evaluate this receipt.
